The workflow can be opened but not tested, activated/deactivated, discarded or extended with Add a Node. (on /object/workflow/c95c78b4-48d2-56f6-8e15-36ff8572f1d8 (Quick Lead workflow editor))
findings.expected: The workflow editor keeps its actions reachable at 768 and 390 px: Add a Node, See Runs, Test and Activate/Deactivate (or a visible overflow menu that contains them), so a workflow can be edited and tested on a tablet or phone.
findings.actual: At 768 and 390 px wide all editor actions disappear. The header only shows the breadcrumb and the global \"Command Menu\" button; there is no overflow menu for the workflow actions. The workflow can be opened but not tested, activated/deactivated, discarded or extended with Add a Node.
reproSteps: Sign in as tim@apple.dev / tim@apple.dev
Open /objects/workflows and click the workflow "Quick Lead"
At a 1440px-wide window the editor header shows: + Add a Node, See Runs, Test, Discard Draft, Activate (and the favourite/chevron/menu icons)

Look at the editor header: only the breadcrumb "Workflows / Quick Lead (2/3)" and the "Command Menu" button remain

findings.name: Name filter treats % and _ as wildcards: "Contains %" returns every workflow
findings.summary: % and _ act as SQL LIKE wildcards: both match every workflow, so the list and both counts (5) claim 5 matches for a search text that appears in no record. Searching for a literal % or _ (e.g. in a workflow name) can never work, and the filter silently shows records that do not match what was typed. (on /objects/workflows)
findings.expected: A "Contains" name filter with the literal text % or _ should return only workflows whose name contains that character (here: none, so the 'No Workflow found' empty state with count 0, as with zzz-no-match).
findings.actual: % and _ act as SQL LIKE wildcards: both match every workflow, so the list and both counts (5) claim 5 matches for a search text that appears in no record. Searching for a literal % or _ (e.g. in a workflow name) can never work, and the filter silently shows records that do not match what was typed.
reproSteps: Open https://5500-ia9vrv4csx3pgsgypfjej.e2b.app/objects/workflows (signed in as tim@apple.dev).
Click the Filter button (top right of the view).
In the filter field picker click Name.
Keep the operator Contains and type zzz-no-match in the Name value field — the list shows the 'No Workflow found' empty state, so the filter works for plain text.

Replace the value with a single % — the list immediately shows all 5 workflows (agent15-afly, agent12-twotab, agent9-trigger-test, Quick Lead, Create company when adding a new person) with the header count 'All Workflows · 5' and the footer 'Count all 5', though none of these names contains a %.
Replace the value with a single _ — all 5 workflows are returned again although no name contains an underscore.

findings.summary: The editor renders as if an empty workflow named "Untitled" with 0 nodes existed: blank canvas, no message, no error, toolbar actions missing. With a malformed id the only feedback is a raw duplicated toast "Invalid value for UUID: \"not-a-workflow-id\"" and the same blank editor stays on screen. (on /object/workflow/{id})
findings.expected: A workflow id that does not exist should show a proper not-found state (\"This workflow does not exist\" / \"Record not found\") with a way back to the workflow list, and a malformed id should not surface a raw GraphQL validation message.
findings.actual: The editor renders as if an empty workflow named "Untitled" with 0 nodes existed: blank canvas, no message, no error, toolbar actions missing. With a malformed id the only feedback is a raw duplicated toast "Invalid value for UUID: \"not-a-workflow-id\"" and the same blank editor stays on screen.
reproSteps: Sign in as tim@apple.dev / tim@apple.dev.
Type the address https://5500-ia9vrv4csx3pgsgypfjej.e2b.app/object/workflow/00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000 in the browser and press Enter.
Observe the workflow editor: breadcrumb reads "Workflows / Untitled (0/0)", the canvas is completely blank and every toolbar button (Add a Node, See Runs, Deactivate, Add to Favorites) is missing.

Repeat with a malformed id: https://5500-ia9vrv4csx3pgsgypfjej.e2b.app/object/workflow/not-a-workflow-id — a raw red toast "Invalid value for UUID: "not-a-workflow-id"" is shown twice and the same blank "Untitled (0/0)" editor remains.

(on /objects/workflowVersions)

findings.actual: Nothing changes: the chip keeps showing "↑Name" and the rows stay in ascending name order (all v1 rows first, the v2 row last). Reopening the Sort panel shows the direction selector back at "Ascending". Only flipping the direction from the sort chip's own small menu (clicking the "↑Name" chip and choosing "Sort") actually reverses the list and its arrow. Happened 2 times out of 2 tries.
reproSteps: Sign in as tim@apple.dev and open /objects/workflowVersions (the "Versions" list).
Click the "Sort" button at the top right of the list.

In the opened Sort panel, click the field "Name" to sort by Name. The chip above the list then reads "↑Name" and the rows are ordered by the version name ascending (v1 rows first, the v2 row(s) last).

findings.name: Reloading a workflow editor blanks its name field, and the next click erases the workflow's name
findings.summary: After a reload the header name field is empty (placeholder 'Name' shown) although the record still has its name (browser tab title 'agent12-name-home - Workflow'). Clicking anywhere that blurs the field sends an update that stores an empty name: the header turns into 'Workflows / Untitled' and the workflow loses its name for everyone. (on /object/workflow/5b450f33-80ab-4f18-8a19-546ecb39e9bb)
findings.expected: After a reload the workflow editor shows the workflow's name (agent12-name-home) in the header name field, and clicking in the canvas does not change the stored name.
findings.actual: After a reload the header name field is empty (placeholder 'Name' shown) although the record still has its name (browser tab title 'agent12-name-home - Workflow'). Clicking anywhere that blurs the field sends an update that stores an empty name: the header turns into 'Workflows / Untitled' and the workflow loses its name for everyone.
reproSteps: Go to /objects/workflows and click '+ New Workflow'. The editor opens with the name field focused and the placeholder 'Name' shown.
Type 'agent12-name-home' into the name field and press Enter. The header becomes 'Workflows / agent12-name-home (2/18)'.

Observe the header: it shows 'Workflows / Name (2/18)' - the name field is empty and shows the placeholder, even though the browser tab title still reads 'agent12-name-home - Workflow'.
Click on the empty canvas area next to the 'Add a Trigger' node.
Observe the header: it now shows 'Workflows / Untitled (2/18)' and the browser tab title is just 'Workflow'; the workflow's name has been overwritten with an empty value.

findings.name: Delay action accepts a negative "Days" value and the test run then fails with a bare "Invalid Configuration" and an empty flow
findings.summary: The Delay action accepts -1 in "Days" with no validation message and saves it. Running "Test" then produces a run that fails with a centred red pill "Invalid Configuration" only: the Flow tab of the run shows no steps at all (neither the trigger nor any action), and the run's Home tab shows just status "Failed" with no error text, so nothing points to the Delay action or the negative value. With Days set back to 0 the same run shows its steps and the chain proceeds to the next action's own error. (on /object/workflow/a47f60c2-8594-404b-a94a-8e6b61646af7 (workflow "agent4-flow"))
findings.expected: The Days/Hours/Minutes/Seconds fields of a Delay action should refuse a negative number (a message next to the field, or clamping to 0), and when a workflow cannot run the run should still show its steps and name the action that is misconfigured.
findings.actual: The Delay action accepts -1 in "Days" with no validation message and saves it. Running "Test" then produces a run that fails with a centred red pill "Invalid Configuration" only: the Flow tab of the run shows no steps at all (neither the trigger nor any action), and the run's Home tab shows just status "Failed" with no error text, so nothing points to the Delay action or the negative value. With Days set back to 0 the same run shows its steps and the chain proceeds to the next action's own error.
reproSteps: Sign in as tim@apple.dev and open the workflow "agent4-flow" at /object/workflow/a47f60c2-8594-404b-a94a-8e6b61646af7 (any workflow with a "Launch manually" trigger and one Delay action works).
Click the "Delay" action node on the canvas to open its panel.
Type -1 into the "Days" field and click elsewhere in the panel so the value is saved (the field keeps -1, no error is shown).
Click "Test" in the workflow header.
Read the run panel that opens on the right: its Flow tab is empty except "Invalid Configuration"; the Home tab reports status "Failed" with no error message.

(on /object/workflow/fff88a6e-a714-42e5-863b-51748a3907fb)
findings.expected: The hour field should refuse a value outside 0–23 with a validation message next to it (its own placeholder states the limit), and the workflow should not be activateable with an invalid schedule; the schedule preview should stay consistent.
findings.actual: Hour 25 is accepted with no error message; the \"Schedule\" and \"Upcoming execution time (UTC)\" blocks disappear entirely, leaving no indication that the value is invalid, and \"Activate\" succeeds — the workflow turns Active with the out-of-range hour saved as its schedule.
reproSteps: Sign in as tim@apple.dev and open /objects/workflows
Click "+ New Workflow", name it "agent9-schedule", click the Trigger node "Add a Trigger" and choose "On a schedule"

In the trigger panel note the fields: Trigger interval "Days", Days between triggers 1, Trigger at hour (UTC) 0 with placeholder "Enter number between 0 and 23", Trigger at minute (UTC) 0; the panel shows "Schedule: at 00:00 UTC every day" and three "Upcoming execution time (UTC)" entries

findings.name: Closing the Test panel without submitting leaves the workflow run stuck in "Running" forever, and every Test click creates another orphan run
findings.summary: Each Test click creates a new workflow run immediately (RunWorkflowVersion fires on the click, before Submit), and closing the panel without submitting leaves the run at status \"Running\". Runs #4, #5 and #6 - Quick Lead were still \"Running\" in /objects/workflowRuns after 5+ minutes (checked at 1440 px after a reload), while runs of the same workflow completed normally in under a second. Nothing in the run list or the run record offers a way to cancel or finish them. (on /object/workflow/c95c78b4-48d2-56f6-8e15-36ff8572f1d8 (Quick Lead) and /objects/workflowRuns)
findings.expected: A test run that is abandoned before the form is submitted should be ended (cancelled/failed) when the test panel is closed, and clicking Test again while a test is pending should reuse or not duplicate the run — a workflow run should never stay "Running" indefinitely, since a Quick Lead run normally finishes in under a second.
findings.actual: Each Test click creates a new workflow run immediately (RunWorkflowVersion fires on the click, before Submit), and closing the panel without submitting leaves the run at status \"Running\". Runs #4, #5 and #6 - Quick Lead were still \"Running\" in /objects/workflowRuns after 5+ minutes (checked at 1440 px after a reload), while runs of the same workflow completed normally in under a second. Nothing in the run list or the run record offers a way to cancel or finish them.
reproSteps: Sign in as tim@apple.dev and open the workflow editor /object/workflow/c95c78b4-48d2-56f6-8e15-36ff8572f1d8 (Quick Lead).

Click the "Test" button at the top right of the editor: the test side panel opens on the right with the "Quick Lead Form" (First name, Last Name, Email, Job title, Company name, Company domain, all empty).
Without filling anything and without clicking "Submit", close the panel with the "X" (Close side panel) button at the top right of the panel.
Click "Test" again, close the panel again without submitting (I did this a second time).
Open /objects/workflowRuns and use See Runs from the editor, or the filter Workflow = Quick Lead, and watch the new runs (#4, #5, #6 - Quick Lead) for several minutes.

findings.name: "Discard Draft" always fails on a newly created workflow ("The initial version of a workflow can not be deleted")
findings.summary: Nothing is discarded: the workflow stays in Draft and a red toast says \"The initial version of a workflow can not be deleted\". The console throws an uncaught page error with the same text and the DeleteOneWorkflowVersion GraphQL request aborts. The button therefore never works on any newly created workflow, which is exactly the state in which a user decides to abandon it. (on /object/workflow/{id})
findings.expected: The draft of a freshly created workflow is discarded (or, if this is not allowed, the control is not offered in that state) and the workflow is gone/changed accordingly.
findings.actual: Nothing is discarded: the workflow stays in Draft and a red toast says \"The initial version of a workflow can not be deleted\". The console throws an uncaught page error with the same text and the DeleteOneWorkflowVersion GraphQL request aborts. The button therefore never works on any newly created workflow, which is exactly the state in which a user decides to abandon it.
reproSteps: Go to /objects/workflows and click "+ New Workflow" (top right); a new workflow opens in the editor with an empty Name field and the "Draft" badge.
Do not add a trigger or an action.
Click the "Discard Draft" button in the top right of the editor.
Observe the red toast at the bottom right and that the workflow keeps its "Draft" badge.
Reproduced on a second new workflow (same steps, another workflow from "+ New Workflow").

findings.expected: The Version trigger field should show a readable value (for example the trigger name 'Launch manually'), or the full text should be reachable (expand on click or a tooltip) so the configured trigger can be read from the version record.
findings.actual: The field prints the raw serialized trigger config, cut off at the panel edge with no ellipsis and no way to read the rest: '{"name":"Launch manually","typ'. Hovering the value shows no tooltip and clicking it does not expand it, so the rest of the value (type, position, settings) cannot be read at any width (390, 768 and 1280 all show the same clipped string).
reproSteps: Sign in as tim@apple.dev and open /objects/workflowVersions.
Click the 'v1' name of any version row (for example the version whose Workflow column is 'agent15-a11y') to open the version record.
